## Other Factors

Although evidence seems to indicate that aerobic training can induce growth in sedentary people, increases in whole-muscle hypertrophy do not necessarily reflect what is occurring at the fiber level. Consistent with its endurance-oriented nature, aerobic-type training appears to produce hypertrophic changes specific to Type I fibers. Harber and colleagues (37) found that Type I cross-sectional area increased by approximately 16% in a group of untrained elderly women following 12 weeks of cycle ergometry training; no change was noted in Type IIa fibers.
